scope.focus: Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918 primary, per user instruction)

project_purpose: Scout is an open-source clinical-genomics web tool: it stores patient cases, VCF variant data and gene panels in MongoDB, and serves a Flask web interface (scout-web) plus a CLI (scout-cli) for loading/analyzing data. Collaborators browse cases/variants, annotate HPO phenotypes, share cases between institutes, and integrate external services: IGV.js alignment viewers (including a remote-URL CORS proxy), MatchMaker Exchange patient matching, cgbeacon2 Beacon submission, Chanjo coverage reports, a Rerunner re-analysis API, LoqusDB, Gens, OMIM/HPO/Ensembl/PanelApp data downloads, and a Phenomizer disease query. Several of these features cause the server to issue outbound HTTP requests whose URLs or request contents derive from request data (the CORS proxy route, the Host-header-derived coverage report URL) or from admin configuration (MatchMaker/Beacon/Rerunner/rank-model endpoints). These are the surfaces examined for CWE-918.

framework_notes: Authentication: the global before_request hook (scout/server/app.py:82-97) enforces login for alignviewers.remote_cors and all cases/panels/variant endpoints; the chanjo report endpoints report.report and report.json_chrom_coverage are explicitly EXEMPT (registered from the external chanjo_report package when SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI is set). LOGIN_DISABLED config can disable auth entirely.

No per-route authorization decorators are used; access control is coarse (logged-in + institute/case ownership checks inside controllers via institute_and_case). alignviewers.remote_cors has NO institute/case binding - any authenticated user can proxy any URL.
CORS is enabled globally by flask_cors.CORS(app) (app.py:53), which matters for the /remote/cors proxy reachability from browser origins.

Jinja templates (scout/server/blueprints/alignviewers/templates/alignviewers/igv_viewer.html:71-72) render cloud public track URLs through url_for('alignviewers.remote_cors', remote_url=...) - the app itself feeds remote_cors with admin-configured CLOUD_IGV_TRACKS URLs, but the route parameter accepts arbitrary URLs from any authenticated client.

Secondary integrations reach the network through wrappers: MatchMaker (scout/server/extensions/matchmaker_extension.py) and Beacon (scout/server/extensions/beacon_extension.py) call scout.utils.scout_requests helpers with URLs built from MME_URL / BEACON_URL config; Rerunner entrypoint from RERUNNER_API_ENTRYPOINT config; LoqusDB api instances from LOQUSDB_SETTINGS config; rank-model link prefix from RANK_MODEL_LINK_PREFIX / SV_RANK_MODEL_LINK_PREFIX config.

coverage_gaps: requests / urllib / flask / query_phenomizer library internals are NOT in this database (only the scout application package, ~50.8k LOC). The final network socket I/O of requests lives in the external library; sinks are therefore anchored at the application call sites (requests.request/post/get/delete, urllib.request.urlopen, and scout's own scout_requests wrappers), and taint must reach those call sites' URL arguments to be reported.

query_phenomizer: cases/controllers.py:837 calls query_phenomizer.query(username, password, *hpo_ids); the package performs HTTP POST to a phenomizer server internally (endpoint fixed inside the library, not visible in this source). It is included as a wrapper sink candidate, but URL-level taint cannot be proven or disproven from this DB.

chanjo report blueprint: scout/server/app.py:36-46 optionally mounts the external chanjo_report package (report.report, report.json_chrom_coverage). Those endpoints are auth-exempt and are the target of mt_coverage_stats' requests.post(cov_calc_url), but their implementation is not in this DB.

Jinja templates are not part of the Python CodeQL DB: igv_viewer.html:71-72 routes admin-configured cloud track URLs through url_for('alignviewers.remote_cors', remote_url=...). The remote_cors route parameter itself is extracted directly from the Python route handler, so this template-side path does not create a gap for the route-parameter source, but template-only URL flows cannot be traced.
flask_mail SMTP sends (rerun/verification emails) and subprocess-based LoqusDB 'exec' instances are non-HTTP network/process surfaces and are out of CWE-918 scope.

The alignviewers remote_static endpoint (request.args 'file' -> send_file_partial) reads local files guarded by session igv_tracks membership; this is a potential path-traversal surface, deliberately NOT recorded as a CWE-918 source/sink.
